# Expansion fixtures

Reduced public provider snapshots captured 2026-09-19. Source URLs and limitations are in `../../../SPORTS_DETAIL_COVERAGE.md` (backend root). Golf/cricket/boxing were captured from their scoreboard/day endpoints; NHL 401777460, rugby 600262 and UFC event 600054045 / bout 401772654 / athlete 3166126 are historical fixtures. They are not replayed into production feeds. NHL includes four shot types plus non-shot events to test filtering; cricket includes non-batting innings placeholders to test omission.
